svg.title: SVG drawing types
svg.desc: Eight vector examples: icon, boolean mark, flat illustration, sketch, chart, diagram, pressure ink, and repeat pattern.

g.text: Eight original SVG studies · geometry, style, layout, and rendering are separate decisions

svg.title: Open book
svg.desc: Two open pages with one center fold.

svg.title: Crescent study
svg.desc: A solid crescent with transparent negative space and a separate small circle.

svg.title: Evening reading
svg.desc: A desk lamp lights an open book beside a vase with a branch.

svg.title: Botanical sketch
svg.desc: Four leaves on a gently curved stem, drawn with deterministic hatching.

svg.title: Illustrative observations
svg.desc: Sample observations 1 to 6 have values 24, 46, 40, 68, 63, and 88. Vertical axis runs from zero to one hundred.

svg.title: Drawing review workflow
svg.desc: A brief branches into geometry and type, and both feed review.

svg.title: Pressure stroke study
svg.desc: A flowing curve whose ink width follows explicit pressure values.

svg.title: Leaf repeat
svg.desc: A regular two-color botanical repeat with a fixed sixty-unit tile.

svg.text: Draw Better SVG · editable paths and shapes · chart data is illustrative
